title: kb-sibling/1 version Hello
description: The version Hello both daemons carry on GET /api/identity (crates/kb-core/src/sibling.rs; assembled by crates/kb-server/src/routes/identity.rs and crates/kb-code-server/src/routes.rs). A sibling client compares sibling_protocol EXACTLY and fails closed on a different major. The rest of the identity body is open. A legacy peer that predates the Hello omits these fields; this schema describes a current binary. Structural lint; the daemon is the authority.
